data.name: Logix Artemis additional 64 KB RAM module
data.product_status: Superseded standalone 8-bit module offer; use matched bank kits.
manufacturing_requirements: Retire/revise this offering to a matched-pair kit. Define separate 64 KiB low-density and 256 KiB high-density bank kits, included modules, compatible host revisions, installation instructions, spares and kit packaging. The old eight-chip module cannot remain under the new electrical rule.
